name: Lumos (Lumos Fiber)
notes: Tier 2. Researched from public lumosfiber.com help center articles only (no sign-in). Lumos (legacy Lumos Telephone, North State in High Point NC, and Virginia ILECs) bills its fiber voice service in Lumos My Account. Lumos is now part of T-Mobile Fiber; its FAQ does not say billing has changed; only customers notified of an account migration are sent to a T-Mobile Fiber migration page, so this dossier reflects the current lumosfiber.com My Account. Re-check when the migration finishes. Registration needs the account number from the latest invoice plus a code sent to a contact on file (or account number and 4-digit PIN, not expressible); the username is an email address. Password 7-20 characters with uppercase, lowercase and a digit (no email or simple numeric runs, not expressible). The NC help article describes signing in with ZIP code then username and password, while the current login asks for the email first. One-time payment: Pay Now / Pay My Bill > Make a Payment > Total Due or Other Amount > Bank Account or Credit Card > accept Lumos Terms > Review Payment > Submit Payment. Every credit card payment (one-time or recurring) carries a $4.00 processing fee; bank account, bank draft and debit avoid it (the engine charges card fees on any card). Recurring payments: Account > Billing Preferences > Set up Automatic Payments (Schedule Recurring Payments; Credit Card or Bank Draft, start date, authorize, Save); savings accounts are returned; change or disable in Manage Automatic Payments. Monthly charges are taken on the first day of each service period. Statement Delivery is a Billing Preferences page but its options are not described (paperless left at family default). Pay-without-signing-in, cancellation, payment arrangements and late fees are not described on current pages (family defaults kept). Support 855.GO.LUMOS (855-465-8667). Reviewed 2026-10-10 (t20 review): re-checked the NC and VA billing-preference articles, the charge-timing article and the T-Mobile FAQ; facts confirmed.

passwordRule.message: Use 7 to 20 characters with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a number.

autopay.note: Recurring credit card payments carry the $4.00 card processing fee; set automatic payments to a bank draft or debit card to avoid it. Savings accounts can't be used and will be returned.

pay_online.note: Each credit card payment carries a $4.00 processing fee. Pay from a bank account or debit card to avoid it.

help.title: Make a one-time payment
paragraphs: Log in and select Pay Now on the My Account home page, or Pay My Bill on the Account Profile page. On Make a Payment choose Total Due or Other Amount, then Bank Account or Credit Card, enter the details, agree to the Lumos Terms & Conditions, select Review Payment and then Submit Payment.
Every credit card payment carries a $4.00 processing fee. Pay from a bank account or with a debit card to avoid it.
Your first month, including installation, is charged when you order; after that you are charged on the first day of each service period. For help call 855.GO.LUMOS.

help.title: Set up automatic payments
paragraphs: From the My Account home page choose Set Up Bank Draft, or open Account, then Billing Preferences, then Set up Automatic Payments. On Schedule Recurring Payments pick Credit Card or Bank Draft, enter the details, choose a starting date, authorize the charges, accept the terms and Save. Savings accounts can't be used.
You can change or turn off automatic payments at any time in Manage Automatic Payments. Make sure they use a bank draft or debit card to avoid the $4.00 credit card fee.
steps: Pick Credit Card or Bank Draft and a start date.
Authorize, accept the terms and Save.

help.title: Register and sign in
paragraphs: Select Register an account. You need the account number from your latest invoice and either a code sent to a contact on file or your 4-digit PIN. Choose an email address as your username and a password of 7 to 20 characters with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a number.
Forgot your username? Use your account number and PIN. Forgot your password? Use your email address. You can also call 855.GO.LUMOS.
